claims.text: At least one recurring-ending candidate, registered from the ICS 196 development set alone before scoring (spec section 3.1, P-2), occurs in the ICS 194/195 text under Perna 2019's re-edition at its registered positions at or above its registered occurrence floor, in the postdictive form registered in spec section 3.3. This does not establish: that any candidate's proposed meaning is correct, or that the candidate predicted an unseen text — occurrence at postdictive strength is a distributional result over two texts, and meaning would require an identifiability stage and adjudication this spec does not register.

evidence.description: The owner's OD-10 act of 2026-11-22 (specification of a realistic next Eteocypriot claim commissioned) and the registered design in spec.md section 3 (preconditions P-1 to P-3, the test of section 3.2, the independence assessment of section 3.3).

falsification_tests: Every registered candidate is below its registered floor or absent at scoring.
